mapping_type_definitions.direct_issuer: event directly concerns the same listed issuer
mapping_type_definitions.direct_underlying: asset directly tracks the affected economic variable
mapping_type_definitions.first_order_sector: asset represents the directly affected industry/sector
mapping_type_definitions.second_order_company: company is exposed through sector, input, demand, geography, or regulation
mapping_type_definitions.unclear_or_invalid: economic path cannot be defended clearly

mapping_confidence.1: economic path is absent or cannot be defended
mapping_confidence.2: plausible but materially ambiguous or weakly documented path
mapping_confidence.3: defensible indirect path with meaningful basis risk
mapping_confidence.4: clear economic relationship with limited mapping ambiguity
mapping_confidence.5: direct issuer/underlying relationship established by construction

impact_materiality.1: unlikely to matter to the asset's economic value
impact_materiality.4: major earnings, cash-flow, or valuation catalyst
impact_materiality.5: the event directly defines the tracked economic variable or issuer outcome

direction_confidence.2: several competing channels make the sign fragile
direction_confidence.3: expected sign is plausible but basis risk is material
direction_confidence.4: strong expected sign with ordinary market-expectation uncertainty

exposure_purity.1: broad/noisy proxy dominated by unrelated exposures
exposure_purity.2: individual company with a material second-order channel
exposure_purity.3: sector basket with direct industry exposure
exposure_purity.4: commodity or thematic vehicle closely tracking the affected variable
exposure_purity.5: same issuer or uniquely direct underlying exposure

backward_compatibility_aliases.legacy_gemini_relevance_score: canonical Stage 2C diagnostic name; original value is unchanged
